everyday.title: Everyday Money
everyday.intro: Banking, budgeting, saving and borrowing. Practise freely — nothing here changes your character's money.

no_effects: This was practice. Your character's money and meters are unchanged — only what you learned carries over.

bank-counter.blurb: Pick the right account, fill the form, and set a PIN nobody is watching you type.

debt-ladder.blurb: You need ₹2,000 for three months. Four ways to get it. Which costs least?

document-hunt.title: Document Hunt
document-hunt.blurb: Find what the bank actually needs to open an account in your name.

goal-builder.title: When Do I Get It?
goal-builder.blurb: Guess how long your goal takes, then find out.

jar-split.title: Three Jars
jar-split.blurb: Your money for the month, and three jars. The bills are already waiting.

rescue-mission.title: Rescue Mission
rescue-mission.blurb: A friend lost money to a fake job site. What do you do, and in what order?

spending-detective.title: Where Did It Go?

surprise-month.title: The Surprise
surprise-month.blurb: Something breaks, and it costs money you had not planned for.

swipe-sort.title: Need or Want?
